title: Global Stability and Asymptotics of Cosmological Spacetimes
exact_target: Determine global stability and asymptotics of the stated cosmological backgrounds under sufficiently small admissible perturbations.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30006048 (OWR-14298591-012). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.

Mathematical Aspects of General Relativity (2024), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2024/36, pp. 2033--2112. Original report and mathematical context. Incorporated report material remains under the source CC BY-SA 4.0 terms unless otherwise noted.

status_qualification: The report already describes established de Sitter and slowly rotating Kerr--de Sitter stability. The broad catalogue wording must not be read as declaring those known cases open; the unresolved parameter and asymptotic extensions need the source hypotheses.
